artifacts.grain: one eligible Flickr photo and BioCLIP route
one routed organism unit and query or target association
one routed organism unit and accepted candidate species
one routed organism unit and deterministic work partition
one deterministic geography, taxon, route and model-contract partition

properties: photo embedding, routed organism, query or target association and candidate-species grains are normalized separately
organism_unit_id reuses the existing target-full-frame scoring-unit identity
one raw visual input and per-content model-input signature may be referenced by many downstream rows without copying image bytes or embedding vectors
Flickr provider accuracy levels remain separate from optional metric coordinate uncertainty
cells are materialized only through the source-supported precision policy
country, admin region, bioregion and mapping lineage remain explicit
missing, invalid, withheld and unassigned geography cannot become false local evidence
family signatures describe batching work and do not remove any candidate species
partition keys use a content-independent model-input contract while retaining exact content identity for cache reuse
every eligible organism unit receives exactly one partition assignment and every partition has a deterministic summary
